screen.title: Ari nina
screen.registerSubtitle: Kikinpak wawata killkakatinamanta ñawpaka, paypak willaykunata kamankapak ari ninaykitami mutsunchik.
screen.documentInSpanish: Kamachik killkaka ishpañol shimipimi rikurin, tikrachishkata allichikukpi.

points.who: OMS-pak tupuykunawan chimpapurashpa imashina wiñakunta rikuna.
points.share: Kay willaykunataka paypak hampik tantanakuywan kamanlla rikuchina.

screen.checkLegal: Ñukami {{name}}-pak kamachik kamak kani, paypak hampi willaykunata hapinkapak ari ninimi.
screen.checkLegalA11y: Ñukami kamachik kamak kani, willaykunata hapinkapak ari ninimi
screen.checkRevocation: Hamutanimi, kay ari ninataka ñukamanta pankamanta ima pachapash kichuy ushanimi.
screen.checkRevocationA11y: Kay ari ninata kichuy ushanata hamutanimi

alerts.grantError: Ari ninata mana wakaychiy usharkanchikchu. Kutin rurapay.
alerts.revokeMessage: ¿{{name}}-pak ari ninata kichunata munankichu? Kutin ari nishkakaman, mushuk wiñay kamaykunataka mana killkay ushankichu.
alerts.revokedMessage: Ari ninata kichurkanki. Ñawpa kamaykunaka kamachik nishka shinami alli wakaychishka sakirin.
alerts.revokeError: Ari ninata mana kichuy usharkanchikchu. Kutin rurapay.
